hints.pyramid: Stretch your arms up into a point over your head, then trace huge stone blocks being dragged under a hot sun.
hints.castle: Mime tall thick walls all around you, a drawbridge being cranked down, and an archer peeking over the top.
hints.knight: Clank along in heavy armor, lower a visor, lift a shield and swing a sword, then kneel and bow.
hints.king: Place a heavy crown on your head, sit on a grand throne, and wave your hand to command people around.
hints.pirate: Cover one eye, hold a hook hand, wobble on a rolling deck, and point a sword at a plank.
hints.sword: Grip a long handle with both hands, swing it in wide arcs, then slide it into a sheath at your hip.
hints.crown: Lift something heavy and precious with both hands, set it slowly on your head, and sit up very straight.
hints.Viking: Put on a horned helmet, row hard with a big oar, then raise an axe and shout silently.
hints.mummy: Wrap your arms around yourself, walk stiffly with arms forward, and unwind long strips from your body.
hints.printing press: Press down a big heavy handle, peel off a sheet, and read it, then repeat quickly over and over.
hints.Stone Age: Hunch over like a caveman, bang two rocks to make fire, and carry a heavy club.
hints.Trojan horse: Show a giant horse being pulled by rope, then climb out of its belly quietly and sneak around.
hints.Silk Road: Lead a camel train across the desert, then touch and show off shiny, soft fabric to a buyer.
hints.moon landing: Walk in slow bounces in a bulky suit, plant a flag, then look back at a faraway round Earth.
hints.Industrial Revolution: Pull big levers like a factory machine, shovel coal, and let puffs of smoke rise from a tall chimney.
hints.Roman emperor: Wear a wreath on your head, drape a toga, and give a thumbs up or down over a crowd.
hints.samurai: Bow deeply, draw a long curved sword in one smooth move, and hold a very still, serious stance.
hints.explorer: Hack through jungle with a machete, unfold a map, look through a spyglass, and point to a far land.
hints.medieval feast: Tear into a huge turkey leg, hoist a heavy mug, toast with the whole table, and laugh loudly.
hints.Renaissance: Paint a big ceiling while lying back on a scaffold, then sculpt marble and admire it.
hints.Magna Carta: Sign a long scroll with a feather pen, then force someone else in a crown to sign it too.
hints.Berlin Wall: Build a long wall between you and someone else, press on it, then smash it down together and hug.
hints.French Revolution: Raise a fist, march angrily with a crowd, wave a flag, and mime a blade dropping from above.
hints.Rosetta Stone: Chisel carvings on a large stone, then puzzle over three lines of strange symbols like a scholar.
hints.Black Death: Cough, show spots on your skin, cover your nose, and stagger as people avoid you.
hints.Ottoman Empire: Wear a big turban, stroke a long mustache, and command huge armies from a big cushion.
hints.Cold War: Shiver and rub your arms, glare at a rival across a border, and eye a big red button nervously.
hints.Gutenberg: Pick tiny metal letters one by one, line them up in a tray, press a big handle, and show the page.
hints.Persian Empire: Show a huge army of marching soldiers, then bow before a king on a tall throne with a long beard.
hints.caveman: Hunch over, drag a heavy club, and draw a mammoth on an imaginary cave wall.
